title: Qt: Export Objects: Support extended selection, save displayed/filtered
description:
Support extended selection and saving the results (asking for a directory if
more than one row is selected and a filename if only one is selected).

Support saving all the currently filtered rows instead of all rows, as a
dropdown to the Save All button. This uses a QToolButton so we can have
a split button that does the prior Save All action when pushed but also
has a drop down menu for Save Displayed/Filtered.

Closes #20948, #20839

AI-Assisted: no
